purpose: The band under the Contact title band: the team lanes side by side (Sales and Support), each with its scope in one sentence and the action that reaches that team, over a row of self-serve channels. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'contact-hub', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `card-grid`, `topic` and `button`. A lane can carry a second link to the system status page, so a reader can check for an incident before opening a ticket.
useWhen: On the Contact page, to route a reader to the team or channel that answers them.
avoidWhen: For a closing ask at the end of a page → use `closing-call-to-action`.
For a grid of product use cases → use `use-cases`.
related: topic` — each self-serve channel is a linked topic.
use-cases` — the sibling band of icon-led topics.
bestPractices: Give it as many lanes and channels as the page has: both rows balance themselves (`card-grid` `layout: 'balanced'`), so two channels split the row in halves, three in thirds, four into 2 × 2 and five into 3 + 2, with no empty cell.
Don't pad `channels` to three or drop one to make the row fit.
Keep each lane's description to one sentence that states what that team handles.
Set `target: '_blank'` on a channel or status link that leaves the site.
